coverage.note: The register covers 2019-20 onward. Post-career league seasons are measured where the provider covers them; missing seasons are gaps, not zero. Cup and European provider rows are excluded from totals because some repeat league totals. Ratings are league-relative.

definition.sell_on_policy: Compute a receipt only when percentage, basis and a public subsequent fee are all evidenced.
definition.universe: Latest published permanent/free departure, excluding current squad, returns and loan-outs

definitions.note: Descriptive cohorts; not an academy register or a model score.

development_scorecard.note: These are descriptive indicators. A later career does not prove a sale was wrong, and a fee does not prove the sale was sportingly costless.
